sentences.text: 1. Fourth and fifth supplementary affidavits filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material brought on record.
3.

The present second bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.341 of 2023, under Sections 376, 506 IPC, Police Station- Atraulia, District- Azamgarh with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.

The first bail application of applicant has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 03.04.2024.
4.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The fact that victim is a deaf and dumb lady, is wholly false.
In fact, in her cross-examination victim has admitted that she has studied up to Class 10th in ordinary school.
In this connection, learned counsel has referred cross-examination of victim recorded before the trial Court.
Victim is aged about 18 years and thus, she is a major girl.
Statement of victim has already been recorded before the trial Court.

Learned counsel has pointed out statement of PW 2,
who is mother of victim, wherein she has stated that when the applicant was sent to jail, she has got him identified from victim and she has told that she (victim) has to depose against him.
Referring to facts of the matter, it was submitted that victim has deposed against applicant at the instance of her mother.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 26.10.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that victim is deaf and dumb girl and her statement before the trial Court, has been recorded with the help of expert.
In her statement before the trial Court, she has made clear and categorical allegations that applicant has molested her and committed rape upon her.
6. I have considered rival submissions and perused the record.
7. As per prosecution version, the victim is an 18 years? old deaf and dumb lady and her statement before trial Court has been recorded with the help of expert.
In her statement recorded before the trial Court, she has made categorical allegations against applicant-accused.
8. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties and all attending facts, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant-accused.

Hence, the bail application is liable to be Nitish Rajbhar vs State Of U.P. on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199902382/
2 rejected.
9.

sentences.text: However, considering period of detention of applicant, the trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and to conclude the same as early as possible.
10. With the aforesaid observation, the bail application of applicant Nitish Rajbhar is hereby dismissed.

(Raj Beer Singh,J.) September 4, 2025 'SP'/-
